items.title: Jerry Blumberg Interview, 1961-04-06
items.q: This was Cuffee and Danny Barker and Kirkpatrick on piano and Groh and Steele. And they had a very warm thing going.

ctx.x: No, no, he went right back in June. His wife was there and they went back, oh, within two or three days after the Stuyvesant engagement closed. That's when he made those records with Don and the drummer.
Steele. And then went back about the next day or two after that, I think.
